title: Fate Writing
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Tianming's figure began to struggle out from the core, a blinding golden light pierced through the air from the distant horizon—the Tianqing Sect's Sect Master Proclamation Arrow had arrived.

text.content: The instant the pitch-black chess piece touched his palm, Chen Ji felt as if something had abruptly gripped his heavenly fate. That sensation was like an invisible eye piercing through countless layers of void, gazing at the coldly glowing chess piece in his palm. The heavenly fate fluctuations from the direction of Tianqing Sect surged like a tide, and he could clearly sense it—the Tianji Record Fragment was responding, the precursor to the fourth page's unsealing.

dialogue.content: Chess piece enters fate, contract sealed. Chen Ji, have you truly decided? The knowledge of the fourth page is no ordinary thing. Losing it will create a crack in your harmony with the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the depths of the fragment, carrying an uncommon gravity.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His consciousness sank into the inner space of the Tianji Record, where the fourth page's position was radiating unprecedented light—a door, a door leading to the ability of 'Fate Writer.' He could feel the power surging behind it, the terrifying authority capable of rewriting established fate. The price was equally clear: once opened, he would forever lose the knowledge of this page, and his Heavenly Fate Value would be reduced by one-third.

dialogue.content: One-third of his Heavenly Fate Value, in exchange for one chance to rewrite fate. Chen Ji quickly calculated the gains and losses in his heart, his expression serene. Or perhaps not. Should I watch Chen Tianming die before my eyes and see my entire scheme collapse?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the void, seemingly sighing. You didn't use this chess piece when Chen Nian was taken, and you didn't use the other chess games Chen Xuan left behind. Now you're making an exception for an adopted son? Chen Ji's fingers gently rubbed the surface of the chess piece, a faint, indifferent curve forming at the corner of his lips. He is not a chess piece; he is my weakness.

choice.prompt: The crossroads of fate: Exchange the fourth page to activate the 'Fate Writer' ability?

choices.text: Trade life for life, activate the ability
choices.description: Sacrifice the fourth page's knowledge and one-third of Heavenly Fate Value to obtain the chance to rewrite Chen Tianming's established fate. The price is heavy, but it is the only way to save someone.
choices.visible_cost: Lose fourth page knowledge, Heavenly Fate Value -33%
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 'Fate Writer' ability, capable of rewriting one established fate node
choices.risk_hint: A dramatic drop in Heavenly Fate Value may expose the fake death identity, while also attracting the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the black chess piece into his brow center. A tearing, excruciating pain erupted from the depths of his Mental Sea; he felt his heavenly fate being forcibly stripped away by some kind of force—that was the knowledge of the fourth page, the mysteries of fate's essence within the Tianji Record, transforming into fuel to activate the ability.

When the pain reached its peak, everything fell silent. Countless fine threads appeared in Chen Ji's field of vision—these were the threads of fate, each connecting cause and effect, pulling the future. And at the end of those threads, he saw the core where Chen Tianming was trapped, along with a crack slowly expanding.

choices.visible_reward: Retain fourth page knowledge and complete Heavenly Fate Value

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers hovered in mid-air, but in the end, he drew them back. His brow slightly furrowed as he rapidly deduced other possibilities within his Mental Sea. However, no matter how he calculated, the conclusion always pointed to the same fact—time was running out.

In the instant of his hesitation, the images transmitted through the threads of fate made his pupils constrict: Chen Tianming's body was visibly disintegrating before his eyes, a result of the trapped core's erosion. If he didn't act now, there were at most half an hour left.

He saw it. Among those intricate threads of fate, Chen Tianming's life force was dissipating at an irreversible speed. The Holy Sect's secret technique was devouring his foundation. If delayed any longer, even if saved, only an empty shell would remain. Chen Ji's gaze cooled; he hadn't felt this feeling of being led by the nose by someone for a long time. Mo Xiansheng was right—he never used his trump cards easily. But never doesn't mean never.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged, sinking his entire consciousness into the core space of the Tianji Record. There, a chess piece radiating dim light hovered above the River of Fate, awaiting his decision. He extended his hand; the instant his fingertip touched the chess piece, a majestic force surged into his divine soul.

dialogue.content: Fate Writer can rewrite one established fate node, but with each rewrite, the caster shall bear that fate's backlash. Are you certain you wish to do this? Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare hint of hesitation.

Chen Ji did not answer. His consciousness transformed into an invisible carving knife, beginning to inscribe upon the River of Fate. The strokes were slow; each brush left deep marks upon his divine soul. Agony rushed in like a tide, but he didn't even furrow his brow—compared to being trampled underfoot in the Servants' Quarters back then, what was this little pain?

text.content: What he inscribed was Chen Tianming's fate structure. The fate structure originally imprisoned within the core was being pried loose by his consciousness, stroke by stroke. The River of Fate began to roar; countless laws of cause and effect twisted and reorganized under Chen Ji's manipulation. This was an extremely dangerous act, because any slight deviation could lead to unpredictable consequences.

choice.prompt: The crucial choice in rewriting fate: Choose the specific method to rewrite Chen Tianming's fate

choices.description: Completely extract Chen Tianming from the trapped fate, granting him freedom. The price is a direct reduction of one-third of Heavenly Fate Value, and the fake death identity may develop fatal flaws.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -33%, fake death identity destabilized
choices.visible_reward: Chen Tianming completely rescued, fate trajectory thoroughly rewritten
choices.risk_hint: A sudden drop in Heavenly Fate Value will alert the Heavenly Dao's Eye, possibly triggering an investigation by Tianqing Sect

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pouring all his divine soul power into the intangible carving knife. Strokes danced like dragons and serpents, inscribing the final mark upon the River of Fate—'Release.' The instant the character was formed, the River of Fate roared like an enraged beast.

At the same time, Chen Ji's body shook violently. A backlash from the depths of fate arrived as promised; he felt his heavenly fate being gnawed by some invisible force. Heavenly Fate Value plummeted—down by one-third, leaving only two-thirds. Worse still, his fake death identity began to fluctuate—in the direction of Tianqing Sect, that stirred heavenly fate fluctuation was rapidly approaching.

choices.memory_label: 陈机以三分之一天命值为代价救出陈天命

choices.description: Only change the outcome of Chen Tianming's imminent death, preserving some connection to the core. The price is relatively minor, but hidden dangers may remain.

choices.risk_hint: Partial rewriting may necessitate using the ability again later, and hidden dangers may explode at critical moments

text.content: Chen Ji's carving knife paused slightly in the air, then changed its trajectory. He didn't choose to sever completely, but gently nudged the thread of fate, causing a subtle shift in Chen Tianming's fate structure. At least... he won't die. This thought flickered through his mind, carrying a hint of helplessness.

The price was much smaller, but Chen Ji knew this was merely a stopgap measure. He could sense that the fate shackles within Chen Tianming's body were only temporarily loosened, not completely released. The next crisis comes, he'll likely need to use the ability again. But for now, there's only dealing with the pressing matter first.

The instant the rewriting completed, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. Blood stained the corner of his mouth, but satisfaction gleamed in his eyes. He watched as Chen Tianming's fate structure within the River of Fate slowly moved—slowly separating from the core that had imprisoned him. Though slow, it was stable and irreversible.

dialogue.content: Success. Chen Ji murmured, his tone carrying a weight of relief. He raised his hand, looking at the faint black pattern on his palm—the mark of the Fate Writer's use, and proof of his contract with this ability. The price had been paid, irrevocable. But he didn't care.

text.content: Meanwhile, in a certain forbidden land of the distant Tianqing Sect, Chen Tianming's body, originally imprisoned beyond escape, suddenly burst forth with intense light. The fate shackles that had bound him for months were崩解, cracks spreading across the core's surface. His consciousness cleared from the chaos; his first reaction was—someone had saved him.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his consciousness, his form dissolving into the shadows once more. His breathing was steady, as if the breathtaking fate rewriting from moments ago was merely an illusion. But only he knew that at this moment, his heavenly fate was already one-third incomplete. The foundation of his fake death identity was beginning to shake.

choices.description: Appear directly to receive Chen Tianming, brothers reunite, but risk exposing himself and breaking the fake death identity.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of fake death identity exposure greatly increased
choices.visible_reward: Reunite with Chen Tianming, possibly gain new intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Tianqing Sect's search parties may happen upon this scene

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated for a moment, then ultimately stepped toward the collapsing core. Regardless, Chen Tianming could not fall into others' hands. His form ghosted through layers of prohibitions, appearing before the core. When Chen Tianming saw that familiar face—the face he had believed long dead—his entire being froze.

Brother! Chen Tianming's voice trembled with disbelief; he struggled to rise, only to find his strength nearly drained. But his eyes overflowed with the joy of surviving catastrophe and gratitude toward Chen Ji. No one knows how you did it, but—thank you.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head, reaching out to help Chen Tianming up. His movements were gentle, but his gaze swept toward the distance—the heavenly fate fluctuation from Tianqing Sect's direction grew clearer by the moment. The Holy Sect's people will discover the anomaly soon. We must leave. His voice was low and calm, as if everything was under control.

text.content: However, at that very moment, a sudden change occurred. From the depths of Chen Tianming's collapsing core, a strand of jet-black light shot skyward—it was the Holy Sect's hidden trump card, the heavenly fate mark they had used to track Chen Tianming. It was frantically releasing signals, conveying the anomaly here to the controllers far away in the Holy Sect.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had been so focused when rewriting fate that he had actually overlooked this layer. The Holy Sect's methods were more sinister than he had imagined—even if Chen Tianming broke free from the core, that mark would make him a hunted prey. This was the Holy Sect's true purpose. They didn't want to trap Chen Tianming to death; they wanted to use him to find what they truly sought.

dialogue.content: It seems the Holy Sect's scheme runs deeper than I imagined. Chen Ji murmured, his tone betraying no panic. He rapidly deduced his next countermeasures within his mind. The mark is already activated; destroying it will only cause the signal to erupt more violently. But if we let it continue—shield it with the Tianji Record Fragment! An idea took shape in his mind.

text.content: He raised his hand, pressing it against Chen Tianming's brow center. The fragment's aura flowed through the connection between him and Chen Tianming into that jet-black mark, beginning to distort the information it transmitted outward in some subtle way. This was another ability of the Tianji Record—Fate Veiling. The price was an additional consumption of some Heavenly Fate Value, but at least it would buy enough time.

In the distant direction of Tianqing Sect, that intense heavenly fate fluctuation finally reached some critical point. The golden light of the Sect Master Proclamation Arrow pierced the sky—that was Tianqing Sect officially intervening in this matter. Chen Ji knew that the disturbance he caused when rewriting fate was too great, already attracting enough attention. But he did not regret. Chen Tianming's life mattered far more than those potential troubles.

In the instant that golden light was about to lock onto this area, the figure of Chen Tianming trapped within the collapsing core suddenly struggled violently—the aftershock of established fate's trajectory being rewritten, Chen Tianming's consciousness desperately seizing this rare opportunity. His fingers had already reached through the cracks in the core, touching a breath of outside air.
